ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels are clustered in a large amorphous patch on the distal left lobe, a vertical high-contrast band on the medial right lobe, and scattered mottling along the outer margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, rounded V-shaped depression with an aperture of approximately 55 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (5-10 pixel depth). Left lobe exhibits lower-frequency irregularity with distinct micro-notches near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves originating at the median notch and extending toward the distal tips with an upward vertical bias.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of high-intensity circular pixel groups (approx. 3-6 pixels in diameter) along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three parallel vertical low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) visible crossing the high-intensity vertical band on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged termination of the distal right lobe tip suggesting historical tissue loss; distinct vertical 'rake mark' scarring on the inner right lobe pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical high-contrast 'comb' pigmentation pattern on the right lobe inner surface.
